method.timing: Fresh serial processes. Three alternating before/final pairs for state-one. One ten-rule observation per version, without a statistical speed claim. Tracing, census, external sampling, and SQL capture are off. CPU excludes policy compilation; its CPU is separately recorded. RSS includes process setup.
method.scope: One state rule over one actual 108562-byte file; all ten batch-six rules over five files, 257073 bytes, including required linter metadata. The ten-rule snapshot has 44 findings, including missing-file contracts. Source replay separately covers one positive and one clean source test per rule. This is not the full 50-rule repository run.
method.python: Same pinned files and rule sets, one worker; source oracle captured in python-state-one-1/oracle.json and python-four-1/oracle.json. Python CPU/RSS observations are single trials, not medians.
method.allocator: All matched controls use the same system-malloc jemalloc override shim. Results do not establish production jemalloc RSS.
method.deadlines: Every command bounded at 115 seconds; controller kills workload at 112 seconds.

beforeQueue.accounting: Inputs coexist before SQL admission. Referenced Arc payloads can also belong to the workspace/document cache; do not sum these categories as exclusive RSS. Syntax size uses the existing cache estimate. Census work is included in this diagnostic span.

finalQueue.accounting: Queue holds unmaterialized consumer descriptions. Referenced Arc payloads can also belong to the workspace/document cache; do not sum these categories as exclusive RSS. Syntax size uses the existing cache estimate. Census work is included in this diagnostic span.

storageEvidence.intermediateTypedCensus: after-state-one-diagnostic replaces 198758 JSON fields/19624497 heap bytes with typed columns; final streaming no longer retains the complete set. Counters are logical storage estimates, not exclusive RSS.

nativeMemoryProbe.limitations: Cumulative process marks and inclusive intervals overlap. macOS allocator statistics cover system-malloc zones; they do not identify rule-exclusive ownership. The absolute stage growth does not prove why baseline peak differs. That difference remains unresolved.

external.limitation: Sample shares are not exact process CPU fractions. External runs are diagnostics and excluded from controls.

nativeDsl.skipped: workspace and three large Python shortcut corpus tests, run workspace separately

verification.repoCheck: final npm run check passed (25 structure checks, TypeScript, boundaries, Windows paths), using isolated index
verification.productionClippy: passed with all targets; bounded first attempt timed out, retry passed
verification.sourceManifestReproduction: Both checked source manifests reconstruct the exact measured workload digest from pinned source, including the required quality linter metadata file and rule ordering.

Evaluation completed but disk filled before parity artifact could be written. Not a valid control.
Intermediate implementation, before final schema sharing, compact input witnesses, and streaming. Retained for regression analysis.

reproduce.nativeTen: Use the same command with typed-facts-ten-four.json. Each run needs a new output directory.

limitations: No full-repository or full-50-rule performance claim.
Intermediate logical heap reduction and lower final RSS do not establish a lower process high-water mark.
The allocator/SQL stage probe identifies where the new execution grows; the baseline peak difference remains unresolved.
Large regex-group enumeration can still construct a complete regrouping environment before output. Projected SQL columns themselves stream in bounded batches.
Non-file-partitioned clauses that read source still retain their source snapshots; preparation deferral is not a bound on all workspace source residency.

installedConfirmation.note: One untraced confirmation for the addon with the new opt-in memory observations. Timing medians above use the typed-streaming addon before that instrumentation-only addition.
